Cinderella Girls.idol_coverage: All 190 idols in the official portal roster, including 91 without a credited voice actor. All 190 detail pages were checked; all 99 credited current voice actors are included.
Cinderella Girls.group_coverage: 39 selected performing groups and ensemble credits from official label/live/archive sources; historical and event-only unit names are not exhaustive.

Shiny Colors.idol_coverage: All 28 current idols and credited voice actors on the official Song for Prism roster.
Shiny Colors.group_coverage: All eight original units, all seven PJ: REFRAC7IONS units, Team.Stella/Team.Luna/Team.Sol, and the Shiny Colors ensemble.

Gakuen Idolmaster.idol_coverage: All 13 idol-course students on the current official roster, including Amaya Tsubame; faculty are outside this idol/singer scope.
Gakuen Idolmaster.group_coverage: Hatsuboshi Gakuen ensemble, Re;IRIS and Begrazia.

coverage.korean_names: Editorial Korean display transliterations based on Japanese names/readings and established Korean fandom usage; not represented as an official Korean localization.
coverage.aliases: Full personal names and full unit names only. Romanized spellings are lookup aliases, not identity evidence. English mononyms of Cinderella foreign idols are omitted to avoid converting unrelated artists.
limitations: No claim to exhaustively cover every historical Cinderella Girls event unit or former voice actor.
Snapshot verified 2026-10-01; newly announced artists require a catalog update.
